title: Documented goals mapped to implementation
description: Compare the source documentation in README.md with implementation anchors src/allocator.c, src/allocator.h, src/main.c. Trace one feature claim to its code path and record any mismatch or evidence gap.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in README.md, src/allocator.c, src/allocator.h.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

practical_outcomes: Evidence map for README.md, src/allocator.c, src/allocator.h
completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
